intro.heading: Elite Autohaus
intro.body:
Established in 2014, Elite Autohaus has been providing quality Pre-Owned Vehicles for over 12 years in GTA and surrounding area. We have helped thousands of customers buy, sell and trade their vehicles.

Elite Autohaus was built on a foundation of TRANSPARENCY and HONEST CAR SALES.

Owners have over 35 years of combined experience in Pre-owned Luxury and Performance Vehicles.

Our many years in business have helped us better understand the needs of our clients and provide them with a quality, luxury vehicle for a fraction of the new sticker price.

We personally hand select each vehicle requested by our clients to ensure that they meet our strict quality standards. We look forward to putting you in the driver's seat of your next dream car.

cta1.heading: Looking to Buy a Car?
cta1.body:
Let us know what you are looking for and we will search nationwide through our established network of dealer and auction partners.

We handle all the details, negotiate the price on your behalf and deliver the vehicle to your door!

cta2.heading: Looking to Sell Your Car?
cta2.body:
We make selling your car a quick and hassle free experience!

We will take care of all the paperwork and cut you a cheque the moment you drop off your car!

yachts.name: 1998 Sea Ray 400 Sundancer
yachts.description: This stunning 1998 Sea Ray 400 Sundancer is one of the finest express cruisers on the market. Powered by twin MerCruiser 7.4L engines, she cruises effortlessly at 28 knots. The spacious interior features a full galley, master stateroom, and a second sleeping area. Recently serviced with new upholstery throughout. Perfect for extended cruising on Lake Ontario and beyond.

Whether you're exploring coastal waters or heading to distant destinations, the performance is second to none.

yachts.name: 2018 Meridian 580 PilotHouse
yachts.description: Step aboard this beautifully designed 2008 Meridian 580 Pilothouse, a stunning blend of luxury, performance, and comfort. Meticulously maintained and ready for her next adventure, this yacht is the epitome of modern cruising with expansive living areas, cutting-edge technology, and top-tier finishes throughout. Offered exclusively by Bluewater Yacht Group, this magnificent vessel is perfect for both lake cruising and entertaining. Previously owned by legendary hockey player Guy Lafluer, Ocean's 10 stands out amongst the rest on the water. Key Features & Highlights: Spacious Interior: This 58 Pilothouse boasts an open, airy salon with panoramic views, a plush seating area, and a full galley equipped with modern appliances. Three Staterooms, Two Heads: Offering sleeping accommodations for up to 6 guests, including a luxurious master suite with a private head and walk-in closet. The forward and guest staterooms offer exceptional comfort and storage. Bridge Deck with Pilot Station: The spacious flybridge features a centerline helm with excellent visibility, a full array of electronics, and ample seating for family and friends to relax while cruising. Outdoor Living: Expansive aft deck with a wet bar, and plenty of space for dining or lounging. The swim platform is ideal for water sports or simply enjoying a day by the water. Performance & Handling: Powered by twin Cummins QSM II 670 HO engines, (1322HP Total) the Meridian 580 delivers smooth cruising performance, offering excellent fuel efficiency and handling at both cruising and top speeds. 13.5 KWH Generator Fully Equipped Galley: A gourmet galley with a full-size refrigerator, microwave, stovetop, and an island counter perfect for preparing meals on the go. Advanced Technology: Equipped with Garmin electronics, Raymarine radar, autopilot, and a fully integrated stereo system. Features like the bow thruster make docking effortless. Impeccable Condition: Her interior and exterior are in excellent condition, featuring high-quality woodwork, beautiful upholstery, and thoughtful detailing throughout. Recent Upgrades: The yacht has undergone regular maintenance and recent updates, including a compelte wax job 04/2025 Additional Features: Yacht Controler Autopilot Generator Air Conditioning/Heating Washer/Dryer Hydraulic Lift for Tender Satellite TV Underwater Lights Teak Cockpit and Swim Platform Whether you're looking for a luxurious getaway or a versatile cruiser for long-range adventures, the 2008 Meridian 580 Pilothouse offers everything you need to enjoy life on the water. This yacht is designed for those who appreciate both style and function, with style that’s equally matched by its superior performance.

yachts.name: 2014 Prestige 550 Fly
yachts.description: 2014 Prestige 550, a yacht that perfectly blends luxury, performance, and innovative design. Built with Prestige’s renowned craftsmanship, this 55-foot motor yacht delivers a true yachting experience—whether you're cruising the coast, entertaining guests, or enjoying a weekend escape. Powered by twin Cummins QSC 8.3 600 HP Zeus pods, this vessel offers impressive performance, joystick maneuverability, and exceptional fuel efficiency. The Prestige 550 stands out with its spacious flybridge, sleek exterior lines, and light-filled interior thanks to panoramic windows and Prestige’s signature open-concept layout. Key Features: 3 Stateroom / 2 Head Layout + Crew Quarters Full-beam master suite with private entry and en-suite head VIP and guest staterooms forward with shared head Spacious aft galley with sliding doors opening to the cockpit – perfect for entertaining Large flybridge with wet bar, grill, lounge seating, and helm Hydraulic swim platform for easy tender launch and water access Upgraded electronics package with Raymarine GPS, radar, autopilot, and VHF Cummins Zeus pod drives with joystick control & integrated auto-trim Washer/dryer, central vacuum, and tons of storage throughout This 2014 Prestige 550 has been expertly maintained, with regular service and detailed records available. Whether you’re a seasoned boater or stepping into luxury yachting for the first time, this Prestige 550 represents outstanding value, performance, and prestige.

yachts.name: 2018 Cruisers 50 Cantius
yachts.description: Step aboard the stunning 2018 Cruisers 50 Cantius, where elegance meets performance in one beautifully crafted luxury yacht. Offered by Bluewater Yacht Group, this well-maintained vessel combines cutting-edge technology, unparalleled comfort, and sleek design to deliver an exceptional boating experience. Originally a fresh water boat since new, it is now in its new home in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Ultra Low Hours! Key Features: Spacious & Modern Interior: The open-concept layout offers an expansive salon with panoramic windows, allowing for abundant natural light and breathtaking views. The main deck features a gourmet galley, a full-size dinette, and ample seating areas, perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying serene moments on the water. Embrace an indoor/outdoor space with fully retractable aft bar window. Three Luxurious Staterooms: Below deck, the 50 Cantius boasts a private full beam master stateroom with an en-suite head, along with two additional guest staterooms that ensure comfort for family and friends. The well-appointed cabins are designed with high-end finishes, creating a refined and restful atmosphere. Top-Notch Performance: Powered by twin Volvo Penta engines, this yacht offers exceptional speed and efficiency. Whether cruising at a leisurely pace or pushing the throttle for thrilling performance, the 50 Cantius delivers a smooth and stable ride. Outdoor Living: The exterior is designed for relaxation and enjoyment, with a spacious cockpit, a retractable sunroof, and an extended swim platform with power staircase. The upper helm station provides excellent visibility and controls, while the sun pad invites you to bask in the sun or unwind with a drink in hand. Advanced Technology: Equipped with state-of-the-art navigation and entertainment systems, including Garmin electronics, Joystick Docking, and a premium sound system. Rare option also features Gyro Stabilizer: 13.5 KWH Kohler Generator: This yacht is ready for both luxurious adventures and easy handling. Additional Highlights: Hydraulic swim platform with power stairs Bow thruster for easy docking Fully equipped galley with high-end appliances Spacious and comfortable fore deck with seating for multiple guests Beautifully maintained, with low engine hours The 2018 Cruisers 50 Cantius is a rare combination of sophisticated design, luxury, and performance, making it the ideal yacht for discerning owners.

yachts.name: 2008 Carver 38 Super Sport
yachts.description: 2008 Carver 38 Super Sport. With its sleek lines, spacious layout, and impressive performance, this vessel is sure to satisfy the most discerning boating enthusiasts. Twin 8.1 Volvo Penta Hours: 415 This Carver 38 Super Sport is a true gem, meticulously maintained and boasting an impeccable condition that is sure to impress. With only 415 hours on its twin 8.1 Volvo Penta engines, this boat offers not only reliability but also incredible power and performance on the water. Step aboard, and you'll be greeted by a spacious and well-appointed cockpit, perfect for entertaining guests or simply enjoying a peaceful day out on the water. The stylish helm station is equipped with state-of-the-art navigation and control systems, ensuring smooth sailing and easy maneuverability. Inside the cabin, you'll find a tastefully designed and meticulously crafted living space. The salon features plush seating, a dinette, and ample storage throughout. The galley is fully equipped with modern appliances, allowing you to prepare gourmet meals while enjoying the comfort of home. Accommodations are no issue on this Carver 38 Super Sport. The master stateroom offers a luxurious queen-size bed, ample storage space, and an en-suite head with a separate shower stall. The guest stateroom is equally impressive, providing comfortable sleeping arrangements for your family or friends. Additional features of this exceptional vessel include: Air conditioning and heating for year-round comfort Generator for extended stays on the water Spacious flybridge with seating and a wet bar Swim platform with ladder for easy water access Full electronics package, including GPS, radar, and VHF radio Premium sound system for entertainment on board From its timeless design to its exceptional performance, this 2008 Carver 38 Super Sport is truly a remarkable vessel. Whether you're planning weekend getaways, fishing expeditions, or cruising adventures, this boat will exceed your expectations at every turn. Don't miss your chance to own this outstanding Carver 38 Super Sport.
